Elena —

Thanks for the heads up and for the screenshot. Short answer: we use EIN for the US vendor profile, but some portals prefer DUNS for master vendor records. I'll loop in Laura (procurement ops) and Monica (vendor onboarding) to confirm the exact field mapping in Coupa and to send a short checklist you can follow so the account completes cleanly.

Next steps:
- Laura: can you confirm if we need DUNS for Coupa at Northstar's buyer instance?

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Trouble creating vendor account in Coupa

Hi Elena —

Coupa buyer instances can be configured either way. For many energy customers we provide both EIN and DUNS, but the portal will validate whichever identifier the buyer has marked as 'required'. To move quickly, please do the following:

1) Upload Redwood's W-9 (EIN) and our DUNS page (both attached).
2) In the "Company Identifiers" section select the number type Northstar wants — if it's rejecting EIN, try selecting DUNS and re-entering the value.
3) If you still see the 'Identifier mismatch' error, forward the portal invite link and a screenshot of the form with the field labels — we can confirm the expected format.

I'm attaching a short vendor onboarding checklist and our PO/Invoice remit details so your AP team has the address and contact for the first PO.

Attachments:
- vendor_registration_form.pdf (fillable)
- PO-terms-v1.pdf

Best,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Elena

Subject: Vendor checklist & temporary workaround

Hi Elena —

Thanks for sending the invite link and screenshot. Two quick paths to unblock:

Option A (fast): I can request that Northstar's Coupa admin set the vendor profile to accept EIN as the primary identifier — ask them to whitelist 12-3456789 (our EIN on the W-9). This avoids DUNS lookup altogether.

Option B (one-time manual): If Northstar prefers DUNS, we can provide an official DUNS certificate (attached) and Monica: (note — name collision) sorry, attachment name below should be 'redwood_duns_cert.pdf'.

I've attached the completed vendor_registration_form.pdf (fillable fields we pre-populated) and a short PO routing summary for your AP:
- Remit to: Redwood Inference, 210 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
- AP contact: ap@redwoodinference.com
- Default payment terms: Net 30 (can be updated via contract)

If you want, I can open a ticket with Coupa support directly — Connor, want me to loop them in or should we have Northstar do that?

Best,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor_registration_form.pdf (PDF, 240KB)]

From: Coupa Support <support@coupa.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@northstar-energy.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor registration (ticket #CS-98721)

Hello Elena / Redwood team,

Thanks for the details and the screenshots. We investigated ticket CS-98721 and can confirm: the "Identifier mismatch" message occurs when the portal's buyer instance is set to validate against Dun & Bradstreet in real time. We've refreshed the DUNS lookup and pushed a retry for the submitted company record. Please try the link again; the DUNS lookup now returns a match for Redwood Inference. If you continue to see a legal name mismatch, please reply with the exact legal name you entered and we'll escalate to a manual review.

If you prefer, we can disable the live DUNS check for this registration and accept the uploaded W-9 while the buyer completes a manual verification. Let us know which path Northstar prefers.

Ticket: https://support.coupa.com/cases/CS-98721

Regards,
Coupa Support Team
